findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "london_airport_transfer_quote" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: book_london_airport_transfer, track_driver, get_driver_route · Public sink: book_london_airport_transfer, lookup_booking, amend_booking, cancel_booking, track_driver, get_driver_route · Destructive: book_london_airport_transfer, lookup_booking, amend_booking, track_driver.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
